lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.photochemistry_correctness
lean.plain: Error at most 0.01 for every system state at t = 1 fs
lean.annotation: The same $W$ occurs in both conjuncts. The compiled program realizes its action on clean inputs, with measurements and classically controlled gates included in the semantics. The approximation conjunct bounds the full output’s deviation from ideal evolution and zero ancillas. The zero-ancilla condition itself is on the input.

lean.name: QuantumComputationSpecs.Algorithms.StoppingPower:QuantumComputation.Specs.ApproximatesTimeEvolution
lean.plain: Full-output operator-norm error on clean inputs
lean.annotation: For the paper’s all-system-states requirement, take P = I: the right-hand projector selects zero-ancilla inputs, but there is no output projection, and one phase must work for every normalized system input. Since the ideal output has zero ancillas, the probability of a nonzero final ancilla word is at most ε² = 10⁻⁴, not necessarily zero.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.Photochemistry.evolutionTime
lean.annotation: One femtosecond is $100\times10^{-17}$ s and the atomic unit of time is $2.4188843265864\times10^{-17}$ s. Their ratio defines `evolutionTime`, approximately $41.34$ in atomic units. That value multiplies $H$ in the target exponential.

lean.name: RealizesUnitaryFromBasisOutcomesAndZeroWorkspace
lean.plain: Unitary action on selected system states with zero ancillas
lean.annotation: The predicate compares the weakest preconditions of the embedded joint unitary and the compiled program, restricting both to the selected system span and zero workspace at input. The same full-register effect is used at every final classical store, so exact realization here concerns the joint quantum output after forgetting that store, not branch-by-branch equality or exact return of the ancillas to zero.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.photochemistryProgram
lean.annotation: The outer circuit prepares the five low-bit factors of an eight-qubit phase-gradient state. The proof removes the other three preparations because they commute through the intervening unitary and cancel with their inverses. The retained preparation and its inverse each cost 174 T gates and are part of the circuit.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.photochemistry_correctness
lean.plain: Error at most 0.01 for every system state at t = 1 fs
lean.annotation: The theorem chooses one joint unitary $W$ for each disjoint placement of the registers. In the approximation statement the system projector is $I$, and the realization statement uses `Finset.univ` for the allowed system basis outcomes. The guarantee covers every normalized system state with zero initial ancillas, including states outside the antisymmetric sector.
